segments.name: Global Integrated Agencies
segments.description: The largest segment, providing media, data, creative, production and enterprise services to clients, accounting for most of the Company's revenues.
segments.evidence: The largest reportable segment was Global Integrated Agencies, which accounted for 88% of the Company's revenues in 2025.

segments.name: Public Relations
segments.description: Segment providing public relations and strategic counsel services to clients.
segments.evidence: The remaining 12% of our revenues were derived from the reportable segments of Public Relations and Specialist Agencies.

segments.name: Specialist Agencies
segments.description: Segment providing specialist communications and other agency services to clients.
segments.evidence: At 31 December 2025, the Company's reportable segments were Global Integrated Agencies, Public Relations and Specialist Agencies, which reflected the way in which performance was reviewed and resources were allocated in 2025.

changes.text: In May 2025, WPP Media replaced GroupM as the name of WPP's global media company.
changes.evidence: In May 2025, WPP Media replaced GroupM as the name of WPP's global media company.

changes.text: In February 2026, the Company announced a simplification of its structure into four operating units, requiring a reassessment of its reportable segments.
changes.evidence: In February 2026, the Company announced the simplification of its structure into four operating units: WPP Media, WPP Production, WPP Enterprise Solutions and WPP Creative
